accents.note: Theme 'auto' follows prefers-color-scheme; index.html applies the saved choice before first paint.

hud-count.purpose: The live rep count on the camera card, read from 2 m.

stat.purpose: Streak, weekly total and clean-rate on Progress.

figure.purpose: Set results and history totals (1.9rem in totals).

brand.purpose: The PumpOff wordmark in the top bar.

coach-line.purpose: The coach message on the camera card.

body.purpose: Running text; intro copy capped at 65ch.

label.purpose: Tab labels, pills, tags, captions beneath figures. Sentence case.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: Thickens the border of a checked appearance option. Not elevation.

shadows.name: active-tab-ring
shadows.purpose: Hairline outline on the active desktop tab pill. Not elevation.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve; ease-out for every state change.

motion.name: colour-change
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour transitions on buttons, tabs and chart bars.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action-coloured button per moment, such as Save set.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>Save set</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 18px; border: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--line, #e3d9cc); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #2a2420); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--act, #c2421b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--act, #c2421b); border-color: var(--act, #c2421b); color: var(--on-act, #ffffff); font-weight: 750; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every non-primary action: white card with a warm hairline.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg>Reset</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 18px; border: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--line, #e3d9cc); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #2a2420); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--fill-strong, #ddd2c4); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--act, #c2421b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions in warn amber, never the action colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 18px; border: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--warn, #8a5a00); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--warn, #8a5a00); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--act, #c2421b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Exercise Chips
components.description: Pill choices for the exercise; the selected one fills with ink, not accent.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--line, #e3d9cc); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #2a2420); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--fill-strong, #ddd2c4); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--act, #c2421b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-active, .ds-chip-active:hover { background: var(--ink, #2a2420); border-color: var(--ink, #2a2420); color: var(--bg, #f5f0e8); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The flat white container with a warm hairline used on every screen.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 18px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #2a2420); border: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--line, #e3d9cc); border-radius: 22px; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Gabarito Variable', 'Gabarito', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-tag { padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill, #ede5da); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-totals { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px 16px; margin: 0; } .ds-totals div { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; } .ds-totals dt { color: var(--ink-2, #665b52); font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-totals dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Gabarito Variable', 'Gabarito', sans-serif; font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; }

components.name: Appearance Option
components.description: Radio tile used for theme and accent choices.
components.css: .ds-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; } .ds-option { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--line, #e3d9cc); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #2a2420); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-option:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--ink, #2a2420); background: var(--fill, #ede5da); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink, #2a2420); } .ds-option:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--act, #c2421b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 999px; flex: none; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); height: 68px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); border-top: var(--bw, 1px) solid var(--line, #e3d9cc); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Figtree', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #665b52); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #2a2420); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--act, #c2421b); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-tab-active, .ds-tab-active:hover { color: var(--act, #c2421b); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
PumpOff looks like a friendly training notebook left open on a warm table: cream paper, white cards edged with a thin warm hairline, chunky rounded numerals, and exactly one bright colour that always means "press here". It refuses the dark-ground, neon-accent gym-app default and the grey-tiles dashboard. The mood is warm, plain and direct, like the coach's voice in PRODUCT.md.

Density follows distance. On the Workout screen the camera card owns most of the phone and the count sits in a huge pill readable from 2 m; History and Progress are read up close, so they tighten into panels of tabular figures. Depth comes from tone and hairlines, never shadows. Three themes (light, dark, high contrast) share one warm neutral ramp structure, and the person picks one of four action colours (tomato by default, teal, blue, berry) that is re-tuned per theme for contrast.

Everything is thumb-first: 44–56 px targets, a bottom tab bar on phones, and one action-coloured button per moment. Motion is short, eased out, and only acknowledges a state change.
keyCharacteristics: Warm single-tint neutral ramp per theme; no cool greys.
One user-picked action colour on pressable things; state colours (ok green, warn amber) kept separate.
Gabarito for headings and big numerals, Figtree for everything else, tabular numbers everywhere.
Flat surfaces separated by 1 px warm hairlines (2 px in high contrast); no drop shadows.
Generous, soft radii (12 / 16 / 22 px) and full pills for chips, tabs and HUD.
Lucide line icons at one stroke weight (2, 2.4 for the active tab).

rules.name: The Press-Here Rule
rules.body: The action colour appears only on things you can press or are pressing (primary button, active tab, focus ring, link underline, selection). It is never a heading colour, chart colour or decoration.

rules.name: The One Bright Button Rule
rules.body: Each moment has at most one action-coloured button; every other button is card-white with a hairline border.

rules.name: The Separate State Rule
rules.body: Ok and warn are their own colours. A counted rep is green, a rejected rep is amber; neither borrows the accent.

rules.name: The Ink Selection Rule
rules.body: Selected choices that are not an action (the active exercise chip, a checked appearance option) are marked in ink, not accent: chips fill with espresso ink, options get an ink border plus oat fill.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the root and on chart axes; every number lines up and can be compared.

rules.name: The Caption-Below Rule
rules.body: Figures lead and their label sits beneath in smaller ink-2 text (the markup keeps dt before dd; layout reverses the order).

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no wide tracking anywhere; letter-spacing is only ever negative, on Gabarito display sizes.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1 px warm line or a tone step, never a drop shadow.

dos: **Do** keep the action colour on pressable things only, one action-coloured button per moment.
**Do** take every surface colour from the theme tokens so light, dark and high contrast all work; check new UI in all three and with all four accents.
**Do** set big live numbers in Gabarito 800–900 on a near-opaque glass card over the camera feed, readable from 2 m.
**Do** use Lucide line icons at stroke 2 (24 px in tabs, 20 px inline).
**Do** keep touch targets at least 44 px (48 px for buttons).
**Do** animate only state changes with the shared ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) in 120–260 ms, and drop all motion under reduced-motion.
**Do** write labels and headings in sentence case.
donts: **Don't** use Inter, Roboto, Arial or default system stacks; the pairing is Gabarito plus Figtree.
**Don't** use purple-to-indigo gradients, cool greys, or more than one accent on a screen.
**Don't** add drop shadows, shadow-heavy cards, glows, blobs or glowing orbs.
**Don't** use emoji as icons, or mix icon sets and stroke weights.
**Don't** build the generic hero → 3 cards → testimonials layout or a grey-tile dashboard.
**Don't** colour state (counted, rejected, error) with the action colour, or decorate with it.
